description:
Vital Recorder 1.16.6 is open on the Windows desktop with the file '0001.vital' from the VitalDB open dataset already loaded in Track mode. The track window shows a full ~3-hour intraoperative recording from a noncardiac surgery at Seoul National University Hospital. Multiple physiological waveforms are displayed including arterial blood pressure (ART, red), ECG leads (ECG_II, ECG_V5, green), pulse oximetry (PLETH, light blue), capnography (CO2, yellow), and airway pressure (AWP, white). The events panel on the right shows four surgical milestones with their timestamps: 'Case started', 'Surgery started', 'Surgery finished', and 'Case finished'.

As an anesthesia quality reviewer, you need to export only the intraoperative portion of this recording — from the 'Surgery started' event to the 'Surgery finished' event — as a CSV file. The pre-operative and post-operative periods should NOT be included in the export.

Save the exported intraoperative segment as C:\Users\Docker\Desktop\intraop_0001.csv

The exported file should contain the vital signs data columns from the recording, covering approximately the surgical period between the 'Surgery started' and 'Surgery finished' event markers.

Login: Desktop user (no login required).
